title: Monoidal coherence on an already represented native tensor
statement:
Fix the finite field $k_0$, prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$,
separated finite-type scheme $X$, native and ordinary derived categories $\mathcal D,\mathcal E$,
forgetful functor $F$, Hom models $M$, representative-compatible $\eta$, and normalized
ordinary closed symmetric structure $(S,\beta)$ as in [lem-sf-native-weil-tensor-adjoints],
using [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models, def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model].
Let $T:\mathcal D\times\mathcal D\to\mathcal D$, adjunctions
$a_K:T(-,K)\dashv M.weilHom(K,-)$, their counit naturality in $K$, and
$\tau:TF\simeq(F\times F)S.tensor$ satisfy exactly that node's displayed
unit-mate formula. There exist a monoidal structure $m$ on $\mathcal D$ with
$h_T:m.tensor=T$, a symmetry $\gamma$ for $m$, coefficient-unit isomorphisms
$\delta:m.unit\simeq single_0(adicConstant)$ and
$\epsilon:S.unit\simeq single_0(ordinaryUnit)$, and
TensorCoherence $c$ [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data] for
$(m,S.monoidal,\gamma,\beta,F)$ and the comparison obtained from $\tau$ by
$h_T$. Its unit is
$$c.unit=F(\delta)\,mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor_0(adicConstant)\,\epsilon^{-1}.$$
The equality $h_T$ is equality of tensor functors, including maps. This assertion
constructs no adjunction and asserts no transposition law for arbitrary arrows.

proof.text: Obtain raw tensor constraints with their faithful-model and forgetful inducing data. Their unit is the literal degree-zero native coefficient object. This step supplies no monoidal or braided coherence axioms for T.

Apply Mathlib Monoidal.induced to the faithful model functor and its inducing data. This proves tensor functoriality, whiskering axioms, naturality, pentagon and triangle. The operations use exactly T.map, so structure eta and proof irrelevance give tensor=T, including maps.

Apply Mathlib BraidedCategory.ofFaithful using the model swap equation. This proves both braiding naturalities and both hexagons. For involutivity apply faithfulness, precompose by the invertible model tensorator, rewrite twice using the swap equation, and use symmetry in the model category.

Turn forgetData into a CoreMonoidal structure. Its oplax associativity gives the TensorCoherence associativity equation for the supplied τ. Its two inducing unitor formulas directly give left_unit and right_unit; the supplied raw swap equation gives symmetry. Take delta=Iso.refl U, epsilon=ordinaryUnit, and c.unit=forgetData.εIso.symm. The raw unit normalization and mapIso_refl prove the exact required equality. Normalize eqToIso of tensor=T and compose with τ. Forgetting is never assumed faithful.

proof_origin.place: Faithful induction of the raw structural lifts: Monoidal.induced, BraidedCategory.ofFaithful, explicit involutivity cancellation, and CoreMonoidal oplax associativity. Geometric lifts remain isolated in lem-sf-native-weil-tensor-constraint-lifts.

lean.statement:
theorem native_weil_tensor_coherence
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (M : NativeClosedHomModels k₀ l X)
    (η : M.weilHom ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).op.prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ M.ordinaryHom)
    (hη : NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X)
      (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
      M.weilHom M.ordinaryHom M.weilRepresentatives M.ordinaryRepresentatives
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) η)
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure M.ordinaryHom)
    (β : @SymmetricCategory _ _ S.monoidal)
    (hmonoidal : S.monoidal = (inferInstance : MonoidalCategory
      (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber))))
    (hS : NativeOrdinaryTensorModels l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber
      M.ordinaryHom M.ordinaryRepresentatives S β)
    (T : (DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)) ×
      DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X))
    (a : ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X),
      Prod.sectL _ K ⋙ T ⊣ Prod.sectR (op K) _ ⋙ M.weilHom)
    (ha : ∀ (K K' L : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)) (f : K' ⟶ K),
        T.map (X := (M.weilHom.obj (op K, L), K'))
            (Y := (M.weilHom.obj (op K', L), K'))
            (M.weilHom.map (X := (op K, L)) (Y := (op K', L)) (f.op, 𝟙 L), 𝟙 K') ≫
              (a K').counit.app L =
          T.map (X := (M.weilHom.obj (op K, L), K'))
            (Y := (M.weilHom.obj (op K, L), K))
            (𝟙 (M.weilHom.obj (op K, L)), f) ≫ (a K).counit.app L)
    (τ : T ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
        (nativeForget k₀ l X).prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ S.tensor)
    (hτ : ∀ A K : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X),
        τ.inv.app (A, K) =
          (S.transpose ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj A) ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj K)
            ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj (T.obj (A, K)))).symm
              ((nativeForget k₀ l X).map ((a K).unit.app A) ≫
                η.hom.app (op K, T.obj (A, K)))) :
    ∃ m : MonoidalCategory (DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)),
    ∃ hT : @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _ m = T,
    ∃ γ : @SymmetricCategory _ _ m,
    ∃ δ : m.tensorUnit ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (adicConstant k₀ l X),
    ∃ ε : S.monoidal.tensorUnit ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (ProEtale.AdicSheaf.unit l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber),
    ∃ c : RingedForgetTensorTransposition.TensorCoherence
        m S.monoidal γ β (nativeForget k₀ l X)
        (eqToIso (congrArg (fun T' ↦ T' ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X) hT) ≪≫ τ),
      c.unit =
        ((nativeForget k₀ l X).mapIso δ ≪≫
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
            (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) 0).app
              (adicConstant k₀ l X) ≪≫ ε.symm)
